name: Tamius Coldwell
role: High Pyrewarden; leader of the Choir
appearance: Tall and stooped, his face hidden behind a veil of fine steel chain.
voice: Only the liturgical "we"; sifts ash through his fingers while he talks and reads it like tea leaves.
backstory: Coldwell has led the Pyrewardens and, behind them, the Choir. He swears the dying king named Kitwin heir, crowned the boy with grains on day 2, proclaimed him kindled, and lit the Long Smoke green-grey on day 9 to accuse the smith and the Watch of stealing the Coal. At the noon council he demanded Isine's seizure and voted alone against the regency.
wants: Kitwin crowned with the Coal, and the death-tithe restored.
fears: A Doomguide from Kelemvor's true church arriving to ask why the Pyrehouse ash makes people smile.
secrets: He reached the king's chamber after the king was dead and invented the deathbed naming.
He leads the Glad Choir and serves Bhaal behind Kelemvor's mask.
He wears the key to the Last Ember casket in the crypt.
He swore to Rook that the Pyrehouse would back Lorard if the Coal were recovered.
dm_only: The flame-stamped coins carry a thread to the casket; the Choir can feel roughly where they are.
